data.long_meaning: Geetiya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'geeta', which means 'song' or 'melody'. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess Saraswati, who represents knowledge, music, and art, is often referred to as 'Geeta'. Thus, the name Geetiya symbolizes the divine gift of knowledge and creativity. The name Geetiya carries the meaning “Melody, Song” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Geetiya usually hope their child will grow to embody melody, song and live with faith, good character and purpose.
